edits.before: - Alistar Headbutt: matchup-defining — The headbutt-pulverize combo starts every play — respect flash range while it is up. It writes your spacing rules. - E Tectonic Disruption is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
